summary.name: Mathias Lafeldt
summary.one_liner: Personal homepage of Mathias Lafeldt, an indie product engineer from Germany who offers freelance product and engineering work.
use_cases: hire a freelance engineer for a project
find a developer for long-term product work
read about a developer's background and tech interests
summary.what_it_does: The page is a personal introduction from Mathias Lafeldt, an indie product engineer in Germany. It says he has run production systems on AWS for a decade and now builds products for other developers. He lists technologies he is currently focused on, including Rust, Zig, TypeScript, Cloudflare, Astro, and DuckDB. He states he uses AI across the product lifecycle, from ideation to marketing. The page also says he has worked on several SaaS products, including a website builder, a chaos engineering platform, and a GraphQL-at-the-edge provider, and that he is available for freelance client engagements.
notable: Ran production systems on AWS for about a decade
Former SaaS work includes a chaos engineering platform and a GraphQL-at-the-edge provider
Open to freelance work from one-time support to long-term product development
caveats: Page is a personal bio, not a tool; no product features or prices are described
Listed in awesome-sre under a talk/article titled 'Simplicity: A Prerequisite for Reliability', but that content is not on this page
